mapper.insert: INSERT INTO h3_account (user_id, account_naver, account_naver_customer, account_naver_access, account_naver_secret, account_date, account_regdate) VALUES (#{userId}, #{naverid}, #{navercustomer}, #{naveraccess}, #{naversecret}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE account_naver = #{naverid}, account_naver_customer = #{navercustomer}, account_naver_access = #{naveraccess}, account_naver_secret = #{naversecret}, account_date = NOW()
